## Checklist

- [ ] 変更は目的に必要な範囲に限定した / The change is limited to the stated purpose
- [ ] Python 3.10、3.13、3.14で全63 testsを実行した / All 63 tests ran on Python 3.10, 3.13, and 3.14
- [ ] checker変更には成功例と失敗例を追加した / Checker changes include passing and failing cases
- [ ] 振る舞いの変更にはpositive・negative semantic casesを追加した / Behavior changes include positive and negative semantic cases
- [ ] 日本語と英語の公開docsを同じ変更で同期した / Japanese and English public docs are synchronized
- [ ] command、path、version、linkを確認した / Commands, paths, versions, and links were checked
- [ ] 設計上の狙いと観測結果を分け、未確認の効果を主張していない / Design goals and observations are separate, with no unverified effect claims
- [ ] 外部通信、file write、dependencyへの影響を記載した / External communication, file writes, and dependency impact are documented
- [ ] 秘密情報、個人情報、顧客データを含まない / No secrets, personal data, or customer data are included
